levels.text:
“Grovel at my feet!” Tama, the self-proclaimed guardian spirit, grants her blessing, increasing the chance to hit of the ally with the highest ATK by 20% for 2 turns. “This is what awaits all who oppose me!” Afterwards, this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 280% of Tama’s ATK to
3 random enemies.
If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the increase in the ally target’s chance to hit becomes 80%.
The number of turns of [Increased Chance to Hit] becomes 4.

“Behold the hidden power of the infamous mononoke!” Kitsunebi, wills-o’-the-wisp born from Tama’s sorcery, attack the enemy in one fell swoop. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 260% of Tama’s ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK.

Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, decreases both the target’s DEF and P. DEF by 25% for
4 turns.
The amounts the target’s DEF and P. DEF are decreased by each become 50%.
If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 1040% of Tama’s ATK.

“Go forth, my minions!” At the start of the turn, this skill grants the ally with the highest ATK [Shield] equal to 30% of their max HP before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it, and 3 [Mini Tama Doll] buffs for
4 turns. Each [Mini Tama Doll] buff is treated as a buff, but has no effects and does nothing. This skill will not activate again until 8 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
Additionally, if the target who is granted [Shield] is an Amber Soul ally, the size of [Shield] is further increased by 200% of the granter’s ATK.
The number of turns of [Shield] and the [Mini Tama Doll] buff each becomes 8.

“Heh-heh! Think you can find me?” If Tama is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage falls below 70% while the number of allies who are alive is 2 or more, this skill grants [Invisibility] to Tama for 8 turns (cannot be dispelled). This skill activates only 1 time per battle.
The number of turns of [Invisibility] becomes 16.
The number of turns of [Invisibility] becomes 32.

The number of turns of [Bleed] becomes 2.

“All who dare oppose Her Holiness will be destroyed right where they stand!” Alexandra sets her sights on the powerful enemy before her, then overwhelms them in one fell swoop. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 320% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK.
The number of physical attacks becomes 5.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attacks, if she is enhanced with [Guardian Knight], the number of physical attacks becomes 10.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 420% of her ATK.

“After the suffering...comes victory...!” At the start of the 7th turn, this skill grants [Guardian Knight] to Alexandra for 20 turns (cannot be dispelled). [Guardian Knight] increases her ATK by an amount equal to 3% of the total damage taken by her before becoming enhanced with this buff, and increases her chance to hit by 80% (her ATK can increase up to 60% of her ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it).

The amount [Guardian Knight] increases her ATK by becomes equal to 5% of the total damage taken by her before becoming enhanced with this buff. The amount her ATK can increase up to becomes 100% of her ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it.
At the start of the 7th turn, additionally makes her skill cooldown time 0.

I will not allow myself to be defeated and leave her behind...!” When Alexandra is attacked, this skill restores HP equal to 15% of the damage she takes to her. Her HP is further restored by 15% of the damage she takes for each Emerald Soul ally other than Alexandra who is alive at the start of the battle (her HP can be restored by a total of 60% max). If Alexandra is defeated by the attack, this skill will not activate. This skill activates up to 3 times every turn.
This skill now activates up to 5 times every turn.

The amount her HP is restored by becomes equal to 20% of the damage she takes. Her HP is further restored by 20% of the damage she takes for each Emerald Soul ally other than Alexandra who is alive at the start of the battle (her HP can be restored by a total of 80% max).

for 1 turn.

(4 stacks max).

Additionally, at the start of the battle, grants 1 layer of [Multi-Barrier] to Artoria (cannot be dispelled). If she takes damage that is equal to 10% or higher of her max HP, 1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify the damage.

Artoria’s scabbard—the vessel for her holy sword—mends weary blades and emboldens her friends. At the start of the battle, this skill increases the ATK of the ally with the lowest SPD other than Artoria by 20% of Artoria’s ATK for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).
The number of turns of [Increased ATK] becomes 2.
The amount the target’s ATK increases by becomes equal to 50% of Artoria’s ATK.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Lost Child’s Thunder. All ally targets’ DEF is further increased by 10% for each time this skill deals a critical hit (total increase of 60% max).
Strengthens Sign of a Good Kid. Additionally, while Nina is enhanced with the [Shield] granted by this skill, when she is attacked, the damage is cut by 40%.
Strengthens Lost Child’s Thunder. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 420% of her ATK.

levels.text:
“Bad kids go kaboom!” Deals 1 physical attack equal to
280% of Nina’s ATK to 5 random enemies. “You can count on me, everyone!” Afterwards, this skill increases all allies’ DEF by 10% for 2 turns.

The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to
380% of her ATK.
Additionally, all ally targets’ DEF is further increased by 5% for each time this skill deals a critical hit (total increase of 35% max).
“Go away!” Dispels 1 debuff from 1 random ally. “Bye-bye~!” Afterwards, this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 320% of Nina’s ATK to 5 random enemies.
Additionally, has a 70% chance to increase the damage all targets of the physical attack take by 10% for 3 turns.
The targets whose debuff is dispelled become 3 random allies.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 420% of her ATK.

“Feel better, everyone~! Here’s Nina’s Special High Five~!” When Nina is inflicted with an action hindering debuff from an active skill, this skill increases the ATK of Nina and the ally with the highest ATK by 10% for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). Afterwards, this skill dispels 2 debuffs from each target.

Additionally, before granting [Increased ATK], this skill takes Nina’s action hindering debuff with the most remaining number of turns, and further increases all targets’ ATK by 10% for each turn remaining on that action hindering debuff (total increase of 40% max).
The targets of this skill become Nina and the 2 allies with the highest ATK.

“I’ll protect everyone from the bad kids!” At the start of the 1st turn, or when an ally other than Nina is defeated, this skill grants Nina and the ally with the highest ATK [Shield] equal to 100% of Nina’s ATK for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled). If a target is already enhanced with the [Shield] granted by this skill, that target’s [Shield] will be overwritten with a new [Shield] equal to 100% of Nina’s ATK.

At the start of the 1st turn, or when an ally other than Nina is defeated, additionally increases the ATK of Nina and the ally with the highest ATK by 5% for 3 turns (cannot be dispelled). A target’s ATK is further increased by 5% for each ally who has been defeated (total increase of 25% max).
The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of her ATK. This also applies to the new [Shield] that overwrites the old one if a target is already enhanced with the [Shield] granted by this skill.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Lightning Flash. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.

Strengthens The Queen's Resolve. The effect that lets Amleth survive with 1 HP and the granting of [Queen’s Resolve] will both not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since after their previous activation, and will not activate from the 33rd turn and onward.

Strengthens Curtains Rise Bright. The initial physical attacks’ and additional attacks’ damage each become equal to 580% of her ATK. If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the initial physical attacks’ and additional attacks’ damage each become equal to 870% of her ATK.

levels.text: Like the lightning that cleaves the night in a moment’s flicker, Amleth flashes her blade, tearing the enemy asunder. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 360% of her ATK to 4 random enemies.

Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, decreases all targets’ P. DEF by 25% for 2 turns. If this skill activates in Auto-Battles or Boss Battles, the number of turns of [Decreased P. DEF] becomes 4. If this skill activates in the Tower of Infinity, the amount all targets’
P. DEF decreases by becomes 50%.
If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 540% of her ATK.

Like the fiery stars that pierce through the darkness, Amleth’s magnificent swordsmanship fells even the mightiest of foes. Deals 4 physical attacks equal to 520% of her ATK to the enemy with the highest ATK. Each time Amleth attacks, she has a 30% chance to deal 1 physical attack equal to 520% of her ATK to 1 random enemy (4 additional attacks max).
The chance to deal the additional attack becomes 50%.
Before the decision to deal the additional attack is made, if Amleth’s remaining HP percentage is 50% or lower, the chance to deal the additional attack becomes 100%.
If this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the initial physical attacks’ and additional attacks’ damage each become equal to 780% of her ATK.

“Even if a cruel fate is what awaits us, if I walk down this path with you by my side, I shall waver nevermore.” At the start of each turn, this skill grants Amleth 1 stack of a buff that increases her ATK by 3% (20 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled).
The amount 1 stack of the buff increases her ATK by becomes 4% (20 stacks max).
The amount 1 stack of the buff increases her ATK by becomes 5% (20 stacks max).

Amleth’s resolve to fulfill her duty as Queen is unbreakable. When she takes damage that would reduce her HP to 0, she survives with 1 HP. Afterwards, this skill grants [Queen’s Resolve] to her for 10 turns (cannot be dispelled). [Queen’s Resolve] decreases Amleth’s ATK by 90% and has the effect of [Immortality]. The effect that lets Amleth survive with 1 HP and the granting of [Queen’s Resolve] will both not activate again until 8 action phases have ended since their previous activation, and will not activate from the 17th turn and onward. If Amleth is attacked and her HP becomes 1 while she is enhanced with [Queen’s Resolve], the number of turns of that [Queen’s Resolve] decreases by 1.
If the granting of [Queen’s Resolve] activates on the 7th turn and onward, [Queen’s Resolve] will not decrease Amleth’s ATK, and only [Immortality]’s effect will remain.
If she is attacked and her HP becomes 1, after the number of turns of [Queen’s Resolve] decreases, additionally restores HP equal to 10% of Amleth’s max HP to her.

380% of her ATK.

580% of her ATK.

“Even if I have no wings and no beak, we’re still family. So, I’m not afraid to leave the nest any more...!” If an enemy attacks, and Cu Sith is not defeated by that attack, this skill has a 30% chance to dispel 1 debuff from the ally afflicted with the highest number of debuffs.

Additionally, before the decision to dispel the debuff is made, if the number of allies afflicted with a debuff is 0, increases the ATK of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 10% for 1 turn (cannot be dispelled).

“I’ll spread my wings of courage and fly without wavering, to the future waiting beyond this sky...!” At the start of the 1st turn, this skill grants all allies [Shield] equal to 40% of the granter’s ATK for 6 turns (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, if a target who is granted [Shield] is an Azure Soul ally, the size of that target’s [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of the granter’s ATK.

“I won’t let anyone hurt my sister. Even after I’m gone, please, protect her...!” Lillicotte deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself 2 times, and has a
70% chance to dispel 2 buffs from the enemy enhanced with the highest number of buffs. Afterwards, this skill deals 4 physical attacks equal to 430% of Lillicotte’s ATK to enemies at random.
The physical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 580% of her ATK.
The number of physical attacks becomes 6.

“Protect Lillicotte in our place. And please...guide her towards the path that is right.” Lillicotte deals damage equal to 20% of her current HP to herself 2 times, and has a 70% chance to dispel 2 buffs from the enemy enhanced with the highest number of buffs. Afterwards, this skill deals 1 physical attack equal to 740% of Lillicotte’s ATK to the 2 enemies with the highest ATK, and has a 30% chance to inflict [Silence] on all targets for 1 turn.

3 enemies with the highest ATK.

The lower her remaining HP percentage is decreased, the higher the physical attacks’ damage is increased (600% of her ATK max). However, the decision to increase Lillicotte’s ATK based on her remaining HP percentage is made with each individual attack this skill deals.

Moineau hurls her dagger laced in nightshade’s nectar that drains the energy of anyone it touches, dealing

Donning a revolving series of masks was my life, after all.” At the start of Moineau’s action phase, this skill copies 2 random buffs from the ally enhanced with the highest number of buffs other than Moineau on to her.
